messages:
julia: thinking about a 'soft-pause' state for canaries — stop new pilot binds but keep existing sessions. goal: avoid immediate rollback and collect diagnostics. thoughts? :thinking:

rahul: +1. key is avoiding oscillation. we should require multiple signals or duration before soft-pause. p95 + error-rate + eval delta sounds right.

maggie: propose short rule set: (1) error_rate_delta > 0.5% for 3m OR (2) p95 > 1.4x baseline for 2m OR (3) eval_fail_rate > 2%. put a 10m cooldown and backoff after repeats. soft-pause != rollback.

dario: observer->controller contract: push signed probe events with tenant_id and confidence. example event:itemized signals + confidence. controller then applies policy and safety budget. provenance is required.

julia: policy knobs: hold_for (how long to keep soft-pause), fallback_weight (partial vs full), cooldown, max-per-hour. should hold_for be tenant-configurable?

rahul: per-tenant overrides yes. partial fallback ok if router supports split-routing and cache semantics. otherwise default to full fallback to be safe.

maggie: ops asks: automatic diagnostic snapshot, golden-check eval queued, and audit trail for every soft-pause. also document session-affinity: ongoing sessions stay on variant until TTL or end.

dario: edge cases: streaming sessions can't be migrated mid-stream; aggregated signals must be namespaced to prevent cross-tenant cascade. include region/tenant in event.

ops-bot: note: deploy-controller v2.9 exposes POST /api/v2/rollouts/{id}/actions soft-pause. docs: https://internal.redwood/rollouts#soft-stop

julia: next: I'll draft a short RFC with event JSON, policy YAML, and a tiny state machine: ramp -> soft-pause -> escalate -> rollback -> recover. will share for review next week. thanks all :sparkles:
